role_in_parent: Records uniqueness of the affine coordinate on the cell.
statement_nl: Let n be a positive integer and j an integer with 0 <= j <= n - 1. For every real x in I_{n,j}, there is exactly one real t in [0,1) such that x = T_{n,j}(t), namely t = n * x - j.

domain_restrictions: x is a real number and x is an element of I_{n,j}
t is a real number and t is in [0,1)
statement_semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: Fix n and j with n positive integer and integer j satisfying 0 <= j <= n - 1. For every real x in I_{n,j}, there exists exactly one real t in [0,1) such that x = T_{n,j}(t); moreover, this unique t is given by t = n * x - j.
quantifier_order: there exists n such that n is a positive integer (fixed parameter)
there exists j such that j is an integer with 0 <= j <= n - 1 (fixed parameter)
for every real x in I_{n,j}
there exists exactly one real t in [0,1) such that x equals T_{n,j}(t), with the explicit value t equals n times x minus j
witness_dependencies: The unique witness is explicitly t = n * x - j, so t depends on x (and also on the fixed parameters n and j).
